toolCandidates.message: The file is executable but no shebang is present
Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted
Access to a protected member _type of a client class
Attribute name "ManagedObjectReference" doesn't conform to snake_case naming style
Formatting a regular string which could be an f-string
Use format specifiers instead of percent format
Do not call `setattr` with a constant attribute value. It is not any safer than normal property access.
Class 'FakeRetrieveResult' inherits from object, can be safely removed from bases in python3
Consider using Python 3 style super() without arguments
Unnecessarily calls dunder method __setattr__. Set attribute directly or use setattr built-in function.
__init__ method from base class 'DataObject' is not called
Consider explicitly re-raising using 'except KeyError as exc' and 'raise exception.NotFound('Virtual Machine with ref %s is not there' % vm_ref.value) from exc'
Prefer `next(x for x in existing if x.key == c.key)` over single element slice
Unnecessary "else" after "return", remove the "else" and de-indent the code inside it
Method '_wait_for_task' is abstract in class 'FakeSession' but is not overridden in child class 'FakeObjectRetrievalSession'
Either all return statements in a function should return an expression, or none of them should.
Consider merging these comparisons with 'in' by using 'method in ('continue_retrieval', 'cancel_retrieval')'. Use a set instead if elements are hashable.
Use a single `if` statement instead of nested `if` statements
Do not explicitly `return None` in function if it is the only possible return value
